cargo.description: Runs the cargo command of an inferred target of a crate or a Cargo workspace, other than build and doc.

cargo-outputs.description: Runs the cargo command of the build target of a crate or the doc target of a Cargo workspace, whose files Nx stores.

run.description: Runs a binary of a crate with cargo run.

lockfile.description: Lets cargo bring a Cargo workspace's Cargo.lock up to date and writes a digest of each member's locked dependencies.
